# **Reporting Security Issues**

We appreciate your efforts to disclose your findings responsibly and will make every effort to acknowledge your contributions.

To report a security issue, go to the project's issues and create a new issue using the security report 'issue template'.

Read the instructions of this issue template carefully. If your report could disclose vulnerabilities or sensitive information, please email [akeoot@pm.me](mailto:akeoot@pm.me) and include the word "SECURITY" in the subject line. Keeping such issues confidential till they are fixed is required to minimize the impact of said issue.

We'll endeavour to respond quickly and keep you updated throughout the process.
